name: @sos-2/telemetry
description: SOS 2.0 Telemetry: the TelemetrySource ingestion contract (pull- and push-based) producing validated, normalized raw observations with capture-level availability marking; an in-memory adapter with explicit gap recording (a gap is UNAVAILABLE, never silence); and an OpenTelemetry-compatible adapter (spans/metrics/logs modeled as types, converted without any OTel SDK at runtime). Telemetry is INPUT, not semantic truth (Work Order W3; requirements R9, R21, R30).
